name: Pieter Botha
bio:
Pieter's journey into motorsport began in his uncle's small-town garage, where he learned the art of welding and metalwork from a young age. He honed his skills repairing everything from tractors to bakkies, developing a practical understanding of mechanics that's hard to match. He joined Sprint V8 Team after a stint with a rally team, drawn by the precision and demands of high-performance track racing.

Pieter is known for his meticulous approach to fabrication. He believes in doing things right the first time, no matter how long it takes. While some might see him as a bit of a perfectionist, his dedication ensures that every component he crafts meets the highest standards. His 'lone wolf' tendency means he prefers working independently, focusing intently on the task at hand. He strives to build components that not only perform flawlessly but also withstand the extreme stresses of competitive racing.

physical.description: Pieter is a stocky man with a sturdy build, reflecting years of hands-on work.

quirks: Always sharpens his welding rod before starting a new project.
Has a specific playlist of Afrikaans rock music he listens to while working.
Keeps a small collection of vintage car parts on his workbench for inspiration.
